findings: Query sharing fixture assumed exactly one sweep across a task boundary. Ordinary browser invalidation can schedule an additional valid sweep. The corrected fixture checks each condition and query/predicate counts together.
The controlled-clock fixture now waits for the registry queue to drain before advancing its clock.

The first Linux execution of the sustained-load functional harness hit its inherited production deadline: 79 of 80 application tasks completed under 128 host-polled assertions before 15 seconds. The raw failure remains retained. Functional conformance now has an explicit 60-second assertion / 90-second watchdog budget; its samples are rejected from production comparisons. Production remains 15 / 45 seconds, with unchanged work and acceptance thresholds.
